mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_credentials (user_id, password_hash, password_changed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{passwordHash}, #{changedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE password_credentials c SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = #{changedAt} FROM users u WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND u.id = c.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
